summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around the advanced-packaging and semiconductor-test chokepoint. The most direct US-listed OSAT exposure is Amkor, while the underfollowed discovery lane points to packaging equipment, probe-card/test interfaces, and handler/inspection vendors that may benefit if AI/HPC packages, HBM, and advanced memory backend flows create capacity, yield, and thermal-test bottlenecks.
